title: Finitely many intermediate fields in a finite separable extension
statement: Let $E/F$ be a finite separable extension of fields [def-pc-field-extension] [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Then the set of intermediate fields $L$ with $F\subseteq L\subseteq E$ is finite.
